name: Counterexample and Limitation Disclosure Registry
purpose: Consolidate all known limitations, failure conditions, and active counterexamples into mandatory review-visible structures.

disclosures.definition: Loss of stability in aspect-binding where transformation history cannot be bounded.
Recursive actualization of divergent continuations beyond resource limits.
Inability to find an admissible orientation minimization.
Mandatory loss of aspect detail during any finite-depth projection.
Breakdown of neighborhood continuity under excessive transformation flux.
Loss of relational distinctions where distinct preimages map to identical images.

governance_rules.rule: Every formal review package must reference these disclosures as structural boundaries.
Failure to disclose a known active counterexample triggers immediate block of review preparation.
